segments.name: Insurance agency segment
segments.description: Provides agency services distributing life and non-life insurance products on behalf of insurance companies to individuals and corporate clients.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we operated one single segment, the insurance agency segment, which mainly consists of providing agency services for distributing life insurance products and non-life insurance products on behalf of insurance companies.

revenueModel.text: The company earns commissions and fees from insurance companies, based on a percentage of premiums paid by the insured, for distributing insurance products, plus advisory fees for brokerage and risk management consulting services.
revenueModel.evidence: The commissions and fees we receive from the distribution of insurance products are based on a percentage of the premiums paid by the insured.

changes.text: In January 2025, the company disposed of its entire ownership interest in the claims adjusting segment, leaving one operating segment.
changes.evidence: In January 2025, we disposed of our entire ownership interest in the operating entity of the claims adjusting segment, which consists of providing pre-underwriting survey services, claims adjusting services, disposal of residual value services, loading and unloading supervision services, and consulting services.

changes.text: In December 2024, Baowang, an online insurance distribution platform, was spun off to BGM as part of a share exchange transaction.
changes.evidence: In December 2024, Baowang was spun-off to BGM as part of the share exchange transaction with BGM.
